text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD#7891 fired — high GPU memory pressure detected in pool gpu-dedicated-west-3. ~80% of nodes reporting CUDA alloc failures. link: https://pagerduty.example/PD7891
pagerduty: Incident created: high-gpu-memory-pressure (PD#7891) — assigned to alex (primary)
alex: acked. i'm on it, pulling logs now. which pools are hit?
incident-bot: Affected nodes: node-gw-12, node-gw-13, node-gw-14. Errors: CUBLAS_ALLOC_FAILURE, cudaErrorMemoryAllocation. avg mem used 94% over last 6m.
tanvi: that matches the kvcache churn spike after the config rollout ~20m ago. can we roll that back?
alex: running quick checks — listing pods on node-gw-13
```bash
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-gw-13
NAME                                READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE         NOMINATED NODE   READINESS GATES
model-server-rwd-13b-0              0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   3          12m   10.0.2.45    node-gw-13   <none>           <none>
batcher-processor-0                 1/1     Running            0          3h    10.0.2.46    node-gw-13   <none>           <none>
```
alex: logs show repeated cuda alloc failures and then oom kill on model-server-rwd-13b
```
[2026-03-14T09:12:03Z] ERROR model-server: cudaMalloc failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-14T09:12:04Z] WARN kvcache: growth rate 1.8x last 10m, fragmentation high
```
luke: also seeing large burst sizes from batcher — it pushed a 2048-seq request spike at 09:10 which likely pushed memory over the edge.
alex: temp mitigation: reduce batcher max_batch_size and enable auto-shedder at 0.5 for the pool. applying patch now.
```bash
# set auto-shedder to 0.5 for pool
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pools/gpu-dedicated-west-3/config -d '{"auto_shedder":0.5,"max_batch_size":512}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
pagerduty: Note: escalation to secondary scheduled in 8m if not resolved.
kim: i'll be on secondary in 10m; @alex please keep me posted for handoff.
alex: summary so far: probable interaction of recent kvcache config + unexpected large batcher request. Impact: ~12 dedicated customers on that pool saw increased 5xx/504s and latency spikes. mitigation steps: rollback large kvcache flag, throttle batcher, restart the rwd-13b pods on nodes 12-14. i'm restarting node-gw-13 model pods now.
tanvi: starting rollback of kvcache flag (rolled out ~17m ago). doing staged revert across the pool.
incident-bot: rollback job queued: 3 nodes to update, 1st batch: node-gw-12.
alex: kube drain + restart model pods on node-gw-13
```bash
kubectl drain node-gw-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl delete pod model-server-rwd-13b-0 -n prod
```
ops-bot: autoscaler triggered: adding 2 spare nodes to pool gpu-dedicated-west-3 (node-gw-15, node-gw-16) to give headroom.
pagerduty: PD note: Incident acknowledged by alex.
kim: taking over the thread now. i'll stay on until stable for at least 30m. @liz-support please coordinate customer comms.
liz-support: on it — notifying affected customers now, tickets created CS-3421, CS-3422, CS-3423. template: "We observed degraded inference availability in your dedicated pool between 09:10-09:35 UTC; mitigation is underway." ETA: 30m for initial message.
alex: node-gw-12/13 memory trending down after restart; node-gw-14 still at ~85%. no new CUDA error logs in the restarted pods for the last 6m.
```bash
# sample nvidia-smi after restart
Fri Mar 14 09:20:01 2026
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 530.41.03    Driver Version: 530.41.03    CUDA Version: 12.1   |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0   A100-SXM-80GB  On           | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off | N/A                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 0   4096MiB /  81920MiB | 10%   Processes: 3
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
tanvi: rollback progressed: node-gw-12 done, node-gw-13 done, node-gw-14 in progress.
ops-bot: new nodes are up and joined pool; load balancer rebalanced traffic.
luke: i've set a temporary canary throttle to 0.4 for rwd-13b to prevent immediate re-exposure.
alex: monitoring logs; memory on nodes now: 62%, 58%, 61%. no cuda alloc failures in last 10m.
incident-bot: PD auto-escalation canceled (ack present).
kim: looks stable. i'll keep watch and handover to next oncall in 30m. recommendation: postmortem with action items — stricter canary on kvcache rollout, limit on max_batch_size in batcher, metric for kvcache fragmentation and an automated shedder threshold.
alex: adding notes to PD ticket and creating follow-up tasks: 1) enforce canary gate 2) add kvcache fragmentation metric 3) add automated fallback to CPU for heavy bursts 4) improve alerts to include "kvcache growth" signal.
tanvi: i'll open PR for auto-shedder fallback and dashboard tile for fragmentation metric.
ops-bot: if no regressions in 18m incident will be marked resolved automatically.
alex: thanks everyone. great quick work. :thumbsup:
